name: ScholarlySources
summary: A local academic paper discovery app that searches arXiv records by meaning, author, and date.
description: ScholarlySources has a React and Vite browser interface and a FastAPI backend. The Python service loads the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence-transformer, stores a local arXiv corpus, ranks natural-language queries with normalized embeddings and cosine similarity, filters by author/date, and can manually refresh the corpus from arXiv feeds.
features: Manual arXiv feed refresh with status polling
Normalized sentence embeddings compared with cosine similarity

sections.title: Project overview
sections.summary: A local single-user app for discovering arXiv papers by natural-language topic, author, and publication date.

sections.title: Semantic retrieval and embeddings
sections.summary: The FastAPI service uses sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 to encode queries and papers, normalizes vectors, and ranks by cosine similarity.

sections.title: Author, date, and result ranking
sections.summary: Search supports partial case-insensitive author matching, inclusive date bounds, relevance or newest sorting, and pagination.

sections.title: arXiv corpus refresh
sections.summary: A manually triggered refresh fetches three configured arXiv feeds, deduplicates papers, rebuilds embeddings, and preserves the previous corpus if refresh fails.

sections.title: React frontend and FastAPI backend
sections.summary: The Vite frontend calls a FastAPI JSON API for filters, semantic search, refresh submission, and refresh status.

sections.title: Local runtime and deployment limits
sections.summary: The backend loads PyTorch and a sentence-transformer model at startup and stores its corpus locally; model memory and local storage make it unsuitable for the free Render image without a separate measured deployment plan.

frontend.reason: The build is staged from the pinned commit; its relative API prefix is namespaced in the temporary build copy only.

compose.reason: Available as an opt-in local service; first startup downloads/loads PyTorch and the embedding model.

render.reason: PyTorch plus sentence-transformer model startup and inference are too large for the target free Render memory budget without measured optimization.
